title: 正文 第八章 深海八部
content_zh:
“小心，它们来了。”幻天盘膝而坐，气海中的本相释放无形光华，使得他的感应力超越平常数十倍。对于成圣封神幻天并不能直接动用，只能使用他附带的能力。比如可以使感应力增强，也可以开发肉身极限力，最让人惊叹的是他的防御之力，堪称恐怖。

    “我们被包围了，上方是一只背生鳞翼、手拿长矛的四臂族人。前方是一头生有九条触手的恶心怪物。后方是一头长有八只腿，腿如钢矛，上方覆盖着厚重的甲壳，手臂上是一对巨大的钢钳。速度很快，极速接近中。”

    “幻兄，你确定没看错。”徐辉询问。

    “没有看错。”幻天点头。

    “看来它们是想赶尽杀绝。只一次来的分别是赤羽飞鳞、幽海天章和霸王蟹。都属于深海八部，是海族精英。”苍岚皱眉。

    “幻兄，怎么回事？”感受着众人凝重的情绪，不明白前因后果的陆典向着幻天问道。

    “来不及解释了。”回答完陆典后，幻天转身对着苍岚说道。“苍岚兄，地上的两只交给你，上面的那一个归我。”

    “幻兄，上面那只最为危险，本来你可以离开的，我……”苍岚没想到这次来的是海族精英，感觉连累了幻天，心有愧疚。

    “没事，我有经验，我那几位朋友仰仗各位照顾。”幻天看向陆典几人，对着徐辉几人说道。

    幻天震动脚掌，地上遗落的一柄重剑飞起，被它握在手中。随便舞动了几下后说道：“还算趁手。”

    手拿三尺青锋，幻天踏步而走，一步一腾跃，几步之后化为一道流光冲天而起。和天上的赤羽飞鳞砰然相撞，没有多余的话语，相遇的一刻便开始生死厮杀。

    “什么，踏步飞行，幻兄果然不简单。”陆典惊讶，没想到这几日一直被它调侃的幻天是如此深藏不露。

    “唯有突破力之极尽，利用极尽之力，才有可能做到微控，使肌肉震动空气，不靠灵气踏步飞行。”能忍小和尚低语。

    “这么说，幻兄的肉身之力已经达到了十万八千斤。”徐辉感叹。“武者一旦可以踏空而行，那就危险了。”

    “霸王蟹交给我，幽海天章交给你们。”苍岚看着踏空而行的幻天，眼神里露出了一丝战意。

    “苍岚兄，你先前已有重伤，我怕……”徐辉担心。

    “无妨。”苍岚拿出一个玉瓶，倒出一滴金色液体，吞入口中说道。

    “苍岚兄，金身液可不能内服。”能忍小和尚劝说。

    “没事，非常时刻管不了那么多了。”苍岚坚毅的脸庞开始扭曲，显得极其痛苦。

    “啊！”苍岚突然仰天大吼，每一个毛孔都开始喷薄金色光芒，化为一道金色人影，冲向了了霸王蟹。他的力量虽然没有幻天强大，但由于有金身液，他的肉身远超幻天。此刻的他如同一只金色的人形炮弹，冲向了霸王蟹。

    “呼啦啦！”一阵碎石滚动的声音传来。一头数丈大小的幽海天章，蠕动前行，九条人腰粗细的触手，随意抽动着，真个隘口都被它所占据。

    “我操，这是什么玩意。”徐辉大叫。回头对着石心月说道：“月儿妹子，你的天杀绝符呢！直接杀了它。”

    “不行，天杀绝符威力太大，在这种逼仄的地方使用，我们会被活埋的。”月儿也被这恶心的庞然大物吓到了，一丝香汗流出，打湿了眉间的几缕发丝。

    “各取所长，游走攻击，绝不可硬碰，杀。”陆典大吼，将王语兰护在身后，几人中数他年长，经验比较丰富，由他指挥最为合适。

    咻！

    一柄丈长铁矛飞速射来，幻天侧身躲避，脚踏石壁飞速上升，与上方俯冲而来的赤羽飞鳞相撞。初次交击赤羽飞鳞惊讶，没想到遇到一位可以踏空而行的武者。在这种逼仄的隘口中对它极为不利。不过它并不担心，在它眼里，人族弱小的如同蝼蚁一般，它可是深海八部之一，何惧之有。

    双方都是一击而退，幻天手持三尺青锋，斜指赤羽飞鳞说道：“杀你如屠狗，可不要夹着尾巴逃跑。”幻天激将，赤羽飞鳞拥有翅膀，一旦飞入高空，将再难击杀。此时将它激怒，让其失去理智，再寻机会一击必杀。

    “找死。”赤羽飞鳞抽出背负长矛，扑击而来，幻天舞动重剑反击。剑矛相撞，铿锵作响，赤羽飞鳞身为妖兽，肉身之力远超修士，比人类更容易达到力之极尽。几番交击之下，幻天发现，赤羽飞鳞肉身之力并不弱于他。

"Be careful, they are coming." Huantian sat cross-legged, and the true nature in the sea of ​​​​qi released invisible brilliance, making his induction power dozens of times higher than usual. The Saint and Conferred God Huantian cannot be used directly, only its accompanying abilities can be used. For example, it can enhance the sensitivity, and can also develop the physical body's ultimate strength. The most amazing thing is his defensive power, which is terrifying.

    "We are surrounded. Above is a four-armed tribesman with scale wings on his back and a spear in his hand. In front is a disgusting monster with nine tentacles. Behind him is a monster with eight legs. The legs are like steel spears. The top is covered with a thick carapace. On the arms are a pair of huge steel pincers. The speed is very fast, and it is approaching at an extremely fast speed."

    "Brother Huan, are you sure you read it correctly?" Xu Hui asked.

    "That's right." Huantian nodded.

    "It seems that they want to kill them all. The ones who came only once are Red Feather Feiling, Youhai Tianzhang and Overlord Crab. They all belong to the Eight Tribes of the Deep Sea and are the elites of the sea tribe." Cang Lan frowned.

    "Brother Huan, what's going on?" Feeling the solemn emotions of everyone, Lu Dian, who didn't understand the cause and effect, asked Huantian.

    "It's too late to explain." After answering Lu Dian, Huantian turned to Cang Lan and said. "Brother Canglan, the two on the ground will be given to you, and the one on top belongs to me."

    "Brother Huan, the one above is the most dangerous. You could have left, but I..." Cang Lan didn't expect that the elites of the sea tribe would come this time. She felt guilty that she had hurt Huantian.

    "It's okay, I have experience. My friends rely on you to take care of them." Huantian looked at Lu Dian and others, and said to Xu Hui and others.

    Huantian shook the soles of his feet, and a heavy sword left on the ground flew up and was held in his hand. After dancing casually for a few times, he said, "It's quite easy."

    Holding the three-foot green blade in hand, Huantian stepped forward, leaping with each step, and after a few steps, it turned into a stream of light rising into the sky. They collided with the red feather flying scales in the sky. Without any unnecessary words, they started fighting to the death the moment they met.

    "What, flying step by step, Brother Huan is really not easy." Lu Dian was surprised. He didn't expect that Huantian, who had been teased by him in the past few days, was so secretive.

    "Only by breaking through to the extreme and using all your strength can it be possible to achieve micro-control, make the muscles vibrate the air, and fly without relying on spiritual energy." The young monk who could endure it whispered.

    "So, Brother Huan's physical strength has reached one hundred and eight thousand kilograms." Xu Hui sighed. "Once a warrior can walk in the air, it will be dangerous."

    "Leave the Overlord Crab to me, and leave the Youhai Tianzhang to you." Cang Lan looked at Huantian walking through the air, with a trace of fighting intent in his eyes.

    "Brother Canglan, you were seriously injured before. I'm afraid..." Xu Hui was worried.

    "It doesn't matter." Cang Lan took out a jade bottle, poured out a drop of golden liquid, and swallowed it in his mouth.

    "Brother Canglan, the Golden Body Liquid cannot be taken internally." The young monk who could endure it persuaded.

    "It's okay, I can't care so much at the moment." Cang Lan's determined face began to twist, looking extremely painful.

    "Ah!" Cang Lan suddenly shouted up to the sky, and golden light began to erupt from every pore, turning into a golden figure and rushing towards the king crab. Although his power is not as powerful as Huantian's, his physical body is far stronger than Huantian's because of the golden body liquid. At this moment, he was like a golden human-shaped cannonball, rushing towards the king crab.

    "Hula!" A sound of rolling gravel came. A Youhai Tianzhang that was several feet in size squirmed forward, with nine tentacles as thick as a human waist twitching at will, and the entire pass was occupied by it.

    "Holy shit, what the hell is this?" Xu Hui yelled. Turning back to Shi Xinyue, he said: "Sister Yue'er, where is your heavenly killing talisman! Just kill it."

    "No, the Heavenly Killing Talisman is too powerful. If we use it in such a cramped place, we will be buried alive." Yue'er was also frightened by this disgusting behemoth, and a trace of fragrant sweat flowed out, wetting a few strands of hair between her eyebrows.

    "Each have their own strengths, attack from afar, and never kill them head-on." Lu Dian shouted, guarding Wang Yulan behind him. Among the others, he was the older and more experienced, so it was most appropriate for him to take command.

    call out!

    An iron spear that was ten feet long came at rapid speed. Huantian ducked sideways and stepped on the stone wall to rise rapidly, colliding with the red feather flying scales swooping down from above. Akabane Feilin was surprised when he met him for the first time. He didn't expect to meet a warrior who could walk through the air. It was extremely disadvantageous in such a narrow pass. But it is not worried. In its eyes, the human race is as weak as ants. It is one of the eight tribes of the deep sea, so there is nothing to fear.

    Both sides retreated in one blow. Huantian held a three-foot green blade, pointed at Red Feather Feiling and said: "Killing you is like slaughtering a dog, don't run away with your tail between your legs." Huantian provoked, Red Feilin has wings, once it flies into the sky, it will be difficult to kill. At this time, anger it and make it lose its mind, and then find an opportunity to kill it with one strike.

    "Looking for death." Chiyu Feilin drew out the spear on his back and pounced on him. Huantian counterattacked with his heavy sword. The swords and spears collided with a clanging sound. Akabane Feilin transformed into a monster. His physical strength far exceeded that of a monk, and it was easier for him to reach the limit of his strength than a human being. After several fights, Huantian discovered that the physical strength of Chi Yu Fei Scale was not weaker than his.
